sources.fact: Current authoritative Brownfield entity is LBBD 78/BB, Tesco Car Park, Highbridge Road.
The current record gives 1500 minimum and 1758 maximum net dwellings on 3.05ha.
The status field is permissioned but the note explicitly says partly permissioned.
The same record identifies 22/00262/FULL as a new application pending decision; its final issued outcome was not verified this wave.
Ownership-status is not-owned-by-a-public-authority, which does not identify a proprietor or title number.
The current record supplies a point and blank geometry, not an exact title or planning red-line.
The 11 November 2019 Planning Committee considered 18/02131/FUL for the southern part of Tesco Car Park and 514 residential units.
The 514-unit scheme covered the southern part of the car park and five buildings; it is a subsite scheme, not proof that all 1500-1758 capacity was permissioned.
Committee resolved to grant subject to Mayor direction, S106 and conditions; this is retained as exact subsite decision evidence.
The 2019 S106 summary secured 35% affordable housing for that 514-unit application; it is not transferred to later or wider BB capacity.
LBBD states Brownfield Register sites still require planning permission.
No exact final decision notice for 22/00262/FULL was verified from accessible official HTML this wave.

examples.result: BB retains 1500-1758 capacity; capacity is not fully consented quantum.
The permissioned field is read with the explicit partly-permissioned note.
The exact 514-home 2019 southern-subsite permission is not multiplied to the whole site.
22/00262/FULL remains pending in the current register until exact later decision evidence is verified.
35% affordable housing belongs to the 2019 subsite case and is not transferred to the wider capacity.
Point geometry and ownership category are not title evidence.
Promotion remains zero until exact current case, site topology, HMLR relation and overlays are verified.
